principles: SaveService remains the sole authoritative inventory/transaction system.
A3 never introduces a second save authority or grants items from UI flags.
Physical Core instances and permanent recipe knowledge are distinct records.
All consumptive operations are atomic, idempotent, and fail closed on ownership mismatch.
Station progress requires authoritative active-session time, not wall-clock or offline catch-up.

physical_instance.invariant: Exactly one physical token XOR escrow/terminal attribute record; never quantity>1; never orphan token/record.

permanent_knowledge.invariant: Research unlock persists after the specimen is consumed; death does not remove knowledge.
permanent_knowledge.manufacture: Creates a NEW finite physical instance; it does not restore the consumed specimen.

uses_condition_equipment_readiness.uses_remaining: A0 persists; A3 decrements only inside commit_cast after A4 attestation.
uses_condition_equipment_readiness.condition: A0 persists 0..100; A3 wear/repair transactions are atomic; condition<=0 blocks equip/use.
uses_condition_equipment_readiness.equipment: A0 owns slot assignment; A3 validates slot/resistance/condition read-only before effect.
uses_condition_equipment_readiness.skill_readiness: A4 Gold attestation required; production Cores remain BLOCKED_PENDING_A4. A synthetic ready dict is not parity.

queue.invariant: A3 escrow remains recoverable after station removal/power loss/reload/full inventory; cancel/collect refunds inputs/specimens, reserved fuel is burned.
queue.fairness: Accepted active deltas apply in stable job-id order; idle time after completion is not banked.

time_receipt.invariant: No offline catch-up; new session_index rebaselines; revision change pauses old jobs; disabled time is consumed not banked.

confirmation.consumer: A6 UI presents warning; user intent is sent to A0/A3 transaction API as event_id + expected_revision.
confirmation.invariant: UI flags never authorize consumption. A3 revalidates ownership/revision/costs at commit.
confirmation.atomicity: transact_once consumes specimen + spares/notes and enqueues research escrow in one SaveService transaction; replay is idempotent.
confirmation.failure: Any mismatch rejects with no partial consume; escrow recoverable via cancel/collect.

inventory_transaction_authority.invariant: Generic drop/transfer/merge/equip/container/reward paths must guard soh_i_* tokens or atomically couple attribute records.

native_evidence_required_from_A0: Positive guard tests for generic drop/transfer/merge/equip/container/reward paths.
Reload/replay preserves one physical Core and attributes.
Station removal/power/revision lifecycle exposes escrow recovery.
Authoritative active-time host integration with no offline catch-up.
